question: 60 data values are divided into 5 groups. The frequencies of the first 4 groups are 6, 15, 21, and 12, respectively. What is the relative frequency of the fifth group? (Write the answer as a decimal.)
solution: The frequency of the fifth group is \(60-(6+15+21+12)=6\), and its relative frequency is \(6\div60=0.1\).
